experimental_unit: one (held_out_family, capacity) instance -- NOT individual requests. 7 families x 3 capacities = 21 paired instances per condition. Requests within one instance are sequentially dependent (cache state carries forward), never treated as independent replicates.
comparison_design: paired: DAGGER_ITER1 vs. OFF_POLICY_LRU scored on the identical 21 (held_out_family, capacity) instances under the identical held-out evaluation protocol.
reported_statistics: wins_ties_losses (DAGGER_ITER1 strictly lower / equal / strictly higher miss_ratio than OFF_POLICY_LRU, per instance)
mean and median state_shift_index per condition

inferential_test.primary_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank test on paired per-instance miss_ratio differences (DAGGER_ITER1 vs. OFF_POLICY_LRU), two-sided
inferential_test.secondary_test: Spearman rank correlation between state_shift_index and the per-instance miss-ratio degradation (OFF_POLICY_LRU's own held-out miss_ratio increase relative to its own training-distribution val performance), across all 42 (condition, family, capacity) rows -- tests whether shift magnitude predicts performance degradation, not just whether DAgger reduces shift
inferential_test.rationale: 21 paired, non-independent-request instances per condition; matches the paired design already frozen for Concern 1 (configs/reviewer_fairness_statistics.json)
inferential_test.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across {primary miss-ratio test, shift-vs-degradation correlation}
inferential_test.effect_size: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation (primary test); Spearman rho (secondary test)
inferential_test.confidence_intervals: bootstrap (10,000 resamples over the 21 paired instances) 95% CI on the mean miss-ratio difference

conclusion_classification: distribution-shift explanation supported (DAgger significantly reduces shift AND significantly improves held-out miss performance)
shift exists but doesn't explain the gap (shift reduced but no significant miss-ratio improvement)
mechanism not supported (no significant shift reduction and/or no correlation between shift and degradation)
mixed by workload/capacity (effect direction or significance differs across families or capacities)
explicit_prohibitions: Do not treat the 40,000 scored requests within one (family, capacity) instance as independent replicates for any test.
Do not select which instances to report after viewing results.
Do not change the test, correction, or threshold after viewing any fold's results.
Do not run this analysis until 42/42 primary rows exist and scripts/experiments/audit_distribution_shift_completion.py classifies the campaign COMPLETE_VALID.
